# JB Contracting ATX

> Family-owned outdoor living and exterior contractor in Austin, Texas. Builds decks, fences, pergolas, patio covers, concrete patios, roofing and siding across Travis, Hays and Williamson counties. Owner John Bernard walks every estimate himself.

Key facts:

- Business name: JB Contracting ATX (also known as JB Contracting and Property Services). Not affiliated with other businesses that share the "JB Contracting" name.
- Owner: John Bernard, who has been building across Central Texas for over a decade and founded JB in 2024.
- Phone: (512) 587-3914. Website: https://www.jbcontractingatx.com/
- Family-owned, licensed and insured. Rated 5.0 on Google.
- Nextdoor Neighborhood Fave 2025 and 2026.
- Free on-site estimates with line-itemed quotes. Handles permits and HOA architectural review.
- Service area: Austin, South Austin, Cedar Park, Round Rock, Brushy Creek, Pflugerville, Leander, Georgetown, Lakeway, Buda, Kyle, Dripping Springs and Manchaca.
